# `hk util check-added-large-files`

- **Usage:** `hk util check-added-large-files [--maxkb <MAXKB>] <FILES>…`
- **Effect:** read-only

Check for large files being added to the repository

## Arguments

- **`<FILES>…`** — Files to check

## Flags

- **`--maxkb <MAXKB>`** — Maximum file size in kilobytes

  **Default:** `500`

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Check files against a size limit in kilobytes.

```sh
hk util check-added-large-files --maxkb 1024 assets/logo.png
```
